visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair and a beige hooded jacket sits at a dining table, eating yellow potato shreds from a small white bowl with black chopsticks. (2) The scene cuts to a woman's hands peeling a large potato over a kitchen sink with a peeler. She wears a white sleeveless top. (3) On a white cutting board, she uses a large chef's knife to slice the potato into thin rounds and then into very fine shreds. Text overlays appear comparing different thicknesses. (4) A split-screen shows the woman stir-frying yellow potato shreds in a white pan, comparing her slicing technique with another's. (5) The woman places the fine potato shreds into a stainless steel bowl and rinses them under running water until the water becomes clear, removing the starch. (6) In a white pan, she pours olive oil, adds minced garlic, and then the potato shreds. She adds soy sauce, sugar, and vinegar using a spoon. (7) The finished dish is poured onto a large white plate, decorated with green scallions. (8) The woman herself appears in a selfie close-up, tasting the dish with a fork and talking to the camera with a satisfied expression.
